explanation: Hard Drive, USB Drive, Solid State Drive, and Cloud Storage are all common methods for storing digital data. A Printer is a peripheral device used to produce physical copies of digital documents, not to store them digitally.

category: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The first four items are traditionally listed among the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Great Wall of China is a magnificent ancient structure, but it is not one of the original seven wonders.
Mass, Length, Time, and Electric Current are four of the seven fundamental SI (International System of Units) base units. Color is a perceptual property, not a base unit of measurement.
